1.t: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

3.t: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,

4.t: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

7.t: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

8.t: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

9.t: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

10.t: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.

11.t: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

12.t: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

13.t: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

14.t: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

15.t: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

17.t: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

18.t: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

19.t: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

20.t: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

21.t: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
